people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem
translations.asv: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
